title: Spiced Eclair Snack
description: A sweet and spicy Indian-inspired snack made with French eclair pastry. Perfect for a snack or dessert.
instructions: Cut the eclair pastry into bite-sized pieces.
In a bowl, mix together smoked paprika, black pepper, and cayenne pepper.
Dip each pastry piece into the spiced mixture, coating evenly.
Place the spiced pastry pieces on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Dot the top of each pastry piece with butter.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until golden brown.
While the pastry is baking, whip heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Dust the whipped cream with confectioners sugar.
Serve the spiced eclair pastry pieces with a dollop of whipped cream.
